item.text:
ResStock 2025 Release 1 assigns AMY (Actual Meteorological Year) weather **by county**, so all modeled housing units in a county use the same weather data.

- It uses a station within the county if one is available.
- Otherwise, it selects the station closest to the county’s **population centroid**, prioritizing stations in the same climate zone.
- If the selected weather file is in a different time zone, timestamps are shifted.

The documentation describes **approximately 1,200 weather stations**, with custom AMY EPW files developed from 2018 data and locations roughly matching TMY3 stations. Assignment is implemented through `options_lookup.tsv`, passed to `ResStockArguments`.

Source: [*ResStock Technical Reference Guide: 2025 Release 1*, §8.1.5, “Mapping Weather Files to ResStock Samples,” p. 52](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=66).
